author: Ada Lovelace
message:
Make the greeting configurable

Add a name argument so the caller can tailor the output.
patch:
diff --git a/greet.py b/greet.py
index 68db5c7..2e18602 100644
--- a/greet.py
+++ b/greet.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
-def greet():
-    print("Hello, world!")
+def greet(name="world"):
+    """Print a greeting."""
+    print(f"Hello, {name}!")
 
 
    # keep this comment indented as-is
